topic: Cross-space channels the deny rules leave open
detail: Not denied: harness transcripts under ~/.claude/projects and ~/.codex/sessions (shared by sessions started without the launcher), orch's data folder outside spaces/ (orch.db, toollog.db; SP-042), the default gh login ~/.config/gh, the shared /tmp (D-53 residual) and /tmp/claude, which checkouts with no space share (no per-checkout TMPDIR).
